title: Notifications permission denied menu state

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When macOS notification permission is denied, CodexPill must render notification modes effectively off and disabled without deleting saved notification preferences.
When macOS notification permission is denied, CodexPill must expose System Settings recovery and route the recovery action to System Settings instead of requesting notification authorization again.

targetSurface: CodexPill Notifications submenu and fake permission recovery runtime

nonClaims: Does not open live macOS System Settings.
Does not exercise live notification permission dialogs.
Does not prove native click automation or live menu-bar interaction.
